title: serrafalcus cavanillesii
intro: Serrafalcus cavanillesii, commonly known as the Spanish lavender, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as stress relief, improved sleep quality, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Serrafalcus cavanillesii include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential therapeutic uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
